name: NINZ Icons for Elementor
author: Shakil Ansary

sections.description:
Ninz Icons for Elementor integrates Solar SVG icons into the Elementor icon library, allowing users to use modern SVG icons directly inside the Elementor editor without any extra configuration.

Features:
* Adds 3 dedicated icon tabs (Linear, Bold, Bold Duotone) inside the Elementor icon picker
* 3,700+ high-quality Solar SVG icons included
* Icons support Elementor color controls via CSS mask-image
* Admin settings page to enable/disable individual icon sets
* Lightweight and fast
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Open the Elementor editor, add an Icon widget, click the icon picker and choose the “Ninz Icons” tab
  4. (Optional) Go to Settings > Ninz Icons to toggle icon sets on or off
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor?

Yes, Elementor must be installed and activated for this plugin to work.

How many icons are included?

3,700+ icons across three styles: Solar Icons Linear, Solar Icons Bold, and Solar Icons Bold Duotone.

Can I disable icon sets I don’t need?

Yes. Go to Settings > Ninz Icons in your WordPress admin to enable or disable individual icon sets.

Can I add my own icons?

Not yet, but future versions may support custom icon uploads.
